text:
Maria G: FYI — noticed a billing spike for GPU spend in us-west-2 this billing cycle. Reserved/commitment utilization is down (~62%) and a bunch of instances show Owner=unknown in the tags. Can infra dig in? :eyes:
Devon L: Can you paste the query or where you're seeing this? I can start a quick reconciliation run.
Maria G: Pulled this from billing_bq.gcp_aws_lines. Quick BQ to surface untagged/unknown cost: ```SELECT account_id, region, resource_type, SUM(cost) as cost, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT tags) as tags FROM `billing.project.aws_usage` WHERE product = 'EC2' AND resource_type LIKE '%GPU%' GROUP BY account_id, region, resource_type ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 200;```
Raj P: Likely culprits: ASG replacements (spot) and some adhoc dev clusters launched without our tag webhook. Spot/replace flow uses a different LaunchTemplate that missed the TagSpecifications. Also see several EBS volumes detached from terminated instances (still accruing).
Devon L: Ok, I'll run the tag-reconcile job against the accounts and produce a list of resource ARNs missing Owner/CostCenter tags. If we need to fix in-place we can use the tagging API. Example: `aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=Owner,Values="" --resource-type-filters ec2:instance`
AutoTagBot: Tag-Scan finished: found 128 GPU instances and 54 EBS volumes missing Owner or CostCenter across prod/us-west-2 and staging/us-west-2 (scan id: 2026-06-05-02). CSV exported to s3://infra-reports/untagged-gpus-20260605.csv
Elaine S: Finance here — we need a per-team chargeback CSV by EOD Fri. Can you map Owner tags -> cost_center codes and allocate the untagged spend proportionally to last known owner where ambiguous? Also we need a short justification line for the invoice reconciliation.
FinanceBot: Automated suggestion: allocate untagged GPU spend by last attached tag history where available; fallback to pro-rata across teams that used the same instance family in the month. Report stub: https://finance.internal/reports/2026/gpu-untagged-recon
Devon L: Short term mitigation: enforce tag-on-create via org policy and add a Lambda to retag spot replacements. Running this command to re-tag current resources (dry-run first): ```for arn in $(aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=Owner,Values="" --query 'ResourceTagMappingList[].ResourceARN' --output text); do aws ec2 create-tags --resources $arn --tags Key=Owner,Value=infra-temp; done```
Maria G: Thanks. Can we also get RI/commitment coverage recalculated after cleanup? If utilization goes back up we might avoid buying extra reserved capacity.
Raj P: I'll own reconciliation + terraform fix: PR to add default tags into launch templates and ASG tag propagation, plus nightly re-tagger job. Will run a one-off to apply tags and then hand off a CSV to Finance. Scheduling 15m sync now.
Maria G: Great — please @Elaine S once you have the CSV.
Devon L: Filed infra issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4829 — tracking remediation + tag enforcement policy.
Maria G: Perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
